name: dumbbell side squat
description: A wide side squat with a dumbbell, bending one leg while the other stays straight. It works the thighs and inner legs.
instructions: Stand with feet wide holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Shift to one side and bend that knee, sitting your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and both feet flat.
Lower until your thigh is parallel to the floor.
Push back to the middle and alternate sides.
